trigger.definition: What causes one execution to start.

values.definition: A person starts it explicitly (slash command, argument-hint, user-invocable: true, or a commands/ file).
The model decides to use it from its description or tool schema (autonomous selection while a person is present).
Another skill, router or agent starts it (user-invocable: false, agent file, or router-assigned advisor role).
A clock starts it (cron expression or one-shot run_once_at).
A harness or external event starts it (hook lifecycle event, webhook, PR activity).

ui.definition: Surface on which a human sees or steers the OUTPUT while it runs (how it is invoked is `trigger`, not `ui`).

values.definition: Result is conversational text in the transcript.
Produces a rendered page, artifact or HTML preview the person opens.
Produces a document file (docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf, plugin package) as the result.
Draws an interactive viewer/canvas inside the host (MCP app, PDF viewer, diagram canvas).
Drives the person's browser or desktop (computer-use, Claude in Chrome).
Nothing human-facing at runtime (headless, background, tool plumbing).

system.definition: External system of record the element reads from or writes to (access level stored per value).

values.definition: Customer/pipeline records: accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities.
Salesforce org/platform metadata and runtime: Apex, flows, OmniStudio, Data Cloud, packaging.
Mailboxes and mail marketing inboxes (read, draft, send).
Calendars, scheduling links and availability.
Team chat and messaging (Slack, Teams, RingCentral).
File storage and office documents (Drive, Box, Sheets, Docs, Adobe assets).
Wikis and knowledge bases (Notion, Confluence, Guru).
Work-item trackers (Jira, Asana, Linear, monday, ClickUp, Trello).
Git hosting and CI (GitHub repos, PRs, Actions).
Operational databases (Postgres/Neon) and their branches, roles and migrations.
Analytical warehouses and BI query engines (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Hex).
Product, web and SEO analytics (Amplitude, Pendo, Ahrefs, Similarweb, Supermetrics).
Design and diagram tools (Figma, Canva, Adobe, Excalidraw, Mermaid).
Accounting, ERP, payroll and spend (QuickBooks, Xero, Gusto, Expensify).
Payments and storefronts (Stripe, PayPal, Square, Shopify, Wix).
Campaign, sequence and ad execution (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Outreach, TikTok Ads).
Prospect and company data vendors (Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, Lusha, Crunchbase, Common Room).
Meeting and call recordings/transcripts (Gong, Fireflies, Otter, Zoom, Plaud, Granola).
Ticketing, ITSM and customer-feedback desks (Intercom, Zendesk, Zoho Desk).
Observability and incident response (Datadog, PagerDuty).
Content management and headless CMS (Sanity, AEM).
Public documentation and web reference (Microsoft Learn, Context7, WebFetch targets, Academy).
Files and code in the working directory of the session.
Claude's own configuration and runtime: sessions, scheduled tasks, environments, plugins, memory.
Acts on nothing outside the conversation (pure reasoning / drafting).

connection.definition: Transport the element uses to reach that system.

values.definition: Reaches the system through an MCP server or connector.
Reaches the system by shell commands or bundled scripts (sf, npx, python, git, curl).
Uses harness built-in tools: file tools (Read/Edit/Write/Glob/Grep) and web tools (WebFetch/WebSearch).
No declared channel; text in, text out.

harness.definition: Agent runtime / product surface in which the element is loaded.

values.definition: Claude Code (terminal, desktop-code, cloud sessions).
Claude web/mobile chat.
Claude desktop app chat.
Claude Cowork (desktop or remote).
OpenAI Codex.
Cursor.
GitHub Copilot.
Devin.
Kimi.
Antigravity.
Muse.

model.definition: Model the element pins; `inherit` means it runs on whatever the host session uses.

values.definition: Runs on the host session's model; the manifest pins none.
Pinned to a Haiku-class model.
Pinned to a Sonnet-class model.
Pinned to an Opus-class model.
Pinned to a Fable-class model.

type.definition: Packaging kind of the element as declared by its manifest.

values.definition: SKILL.md bundle of instructions (plus references/scripts).
Markdown slash-command file under commands/.
Sub-agent definition under agents/ with its own model and prompt.
Distribution package declared by plugin.json that ships other elements.
MCP server or connector exposing tools (from .mcp.json or the session tool registry).
Stored prompt fired by a schedule (routine / trigger).
Shell/Python handler bound to a harness lifecycle event.

access_levels.write: At least one create/update/delete/send/merge-like operation is evidenced or granted.
access_levels.unknown: Manifest names the system but gives no operation list.
